news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 following the company's Q2 2026 results and regulatory update. The move reflects growing analyst confidence in the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8M (beating consensus) and a net loss of $1.22/share, while confirming $810.3M in cash that is expected to fund operations into 2030 and reaffirming that US and UK regulatory submissions for AMT-130 remain on track for Q3 2026. Shares rose roughly 5% on the update.

news.headline: uniQure: JPMorgan reports 7% ownership stake
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. disclosed passive beneficial ownership of about 4.87 million uniQure ordinary shares, representing roughly 7.0% of shares outstanding, in a Schedule 13G filing.

news.headline: uniQure CEO exercises options, sells 21,082 shares
news.summary: CEO Matthew Kapusta exercised options on 21,082 shares at $19.39 and sold them at roughly $44-$46 under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, part of a broader wave of insider stock sales by uniQure directors and executives in early July.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 each, including full exercise of the underwriters' overallotment option, raising aggregate gross proceeds of $259 million to fund AMT-130 commercialization readiness and the planned confirmatory study.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: Following a Type B meeting, the FDA communicated that 3-year Phase I/II data on AMT-130 would be acceptable as the primary basis for a Biologics License Application seeking accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, with the FDA also open to a non-sham, standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study. uniQure said it plans to file the BLA in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: US FDA BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, using 3-year Phase I/II data, following FDA alignment reached in June 2026.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorization application (MAA) for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130, following a successful pre-submission meeting earlier in 2026.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory study design alignment with FDA
catalysts.detail: uniQure is finalizing the design of the required confirmatory study (potentially standard-of-care controlled rather than sham-surgery controlled) with the FDA ahead of the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Updates on additional international regulatory pathways
catalysts.detail: Company has stated it is pursuing registration pathways for AMT-130 in other international markets (including potential EU/EMA engagement) and expects to provide updates in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial launch of AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If accelerated approval is granted, uniQure intends to commercially launch AMT-130 for Huntington's disease; the $259M June 2026 raise was earmarked partly to fund launch readiness, but launch timing itself is not yet confirmed.

catalysts.label: Potential ex-US partnership or business development deal
catalysts.detail: uniQure has flagged 'business development initiatives' as a use of proceeds from its recent raise, fueling speculation about a possible partnership or licensing deal for AMT-130 or its pipeline assets, though no deal has been announced.

pulse: uniQure had a pivotal six weeks: the FDA agreed (June 17) that existing 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, the company closed a $259M raise (June 25) pushing its cash runway into 2030, and Q2 2026 results (July 29) beat revenue estimates and reaffirmed Q3 2026 US/UK filing plans, sending shares higher and prompting price-target hikes (Wells Fargo to $75). Attention now turns to the actual BLA/MAA filings expected in Q3 2026 and finalization of the confirmatory trial design, against a backdrop of a still-widening net loss and notable recent insider selling.
